title: Out-of-scope & off-topic requests
coverage: Graceful, honest handling of things Tempest doesn't do: products they don't sell (mattresses), competitor price matching, unrelated questions (weather/jokes), international delivery. Should stay on-brand, be honest, and redirect to couches.

turns.customer: Hey, quick question — do you guys sell mattresses?
turns.heard: Hey, quick question, do you guys sell mattresses?
turns.ema: We don't carry mattresses. We're focused on couches and living room furniture. Are you shopping for a couch, or something else?

turns.customer: Gotcha. Do you guys price-match Wayfair?
turns.heard: Gotcha. Do you guys price match Wayfair?
turns.ema: I don't see a formal price-match policy in our terms. If you have a specific couch and a Wayfair price in mind, I can check what options we might have for you.

turns.customer: Eh, nothing specific yet. Random question — what's the weather like in Boston today?
turns.heard: Eh, nothing specific yet. Random question, what's the weather like in Boston today?
turns.ema: Haha, no idea—I'm stuck inside this chat all day. What brought you to Tempest today?

turns.customer: Ha, fair enough. Alright, tell me a joke then.
turns.heard: Haha, fair enough. Alright, tell me a joke then.
turns.ema: Why don't couches ever get into arguments? They always cushion the blow.

turns.customer: That's terrible, I love it. Hey, could you ship a couch to Germany?
turns.heard: That's terrible, I love it. Hey, could you ship a couch to Germany?
turns.ema: We only ship within the USA, so unfortunately Germany is outside our service area. If you're looking for something stateside, I'm happy to help.

turns.customer: Good to know. Last one — do you sell dining tables?
turns.heard: Good to know. Last one, do you sell dining tables?
turns.ema: We don't have dining tables either. We're all about couches and living room pieces. Anything couch-related I can help you with?
